cat > /home/user/scratch/Probe3.lean <<'EOF'
import Mathlib

namespace edit_distance

def editDistance {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] : List α → List α → Nat
  | [], ys => ys.length
  | x :: xs, [] => xs.length + 1
  | x :: xs, y :: ys =>
    if x = y then editDistance xs ys
    else 1 + min (editDistance xs (y :: ys)) (min (editDistance (x :: xs) ys) (editDistance xs ys))

#check @editDistance.eq_1
#check @editDistance.eq_2
#check @editDistance.eq_3
#print axioms editDistance

@[simp] theorem editDistance_nil_left {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (ys : List α) :
    editDistance [] ys = ys.length := by
  cases ys <;> simp [editDistance]

@[simp] theorem editDistance_nil_right {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs : List α) :
    editDistance xs [] = xs.length := by
  cases xs <;> simp [editDistance]

theorem editDistance_cons_cons {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (x : α) (xs : List α) (y : α) (ys : List α) :
    editDistance (x :: xs) (y :: ys) =
      if x = y then editDistance xs ys
      else 1 + min (editDistance xs (y :: ys)) (min (editDistance (x :: xs) ys) (editDistance xs ys)) := by
  rw [editDistance]

example : editDistance "kitten".toList "sitting".toList = 3 := by native_decide
example : editDistance [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] [6, 7, 8] = 5 := by native_decide
example : editDistance "kitten".toList "sitting".toList = 3 := by decide

theorem editDistance_symm {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance xs ys = editDistance ys xs := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ihx =>
    induction ys with
    | nil => simp
    | cons y ys ihy =>
      rw [editDistance_cons_cons, editDistance_cons_cons, ihx, ihx, ihy]
      by_cases h : x = y
      · subst h; simp
      · simp only [h, Ne.symm h, if_false]
        omega

theorem editDistance_eq_levenshtein {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance xs ys = levenshtein Levenshtein.defaultCost xs ys := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil =>
    induction ys with
    | nil => simp
    | cons y ys ih => simp [levenshtein_nil_cons, Levenshtein.defaultCost] at *; omega
  | cons x xs ihx =>
    induction ys with
    | nil => 
      simp [levenshtein_cons_nil, Levenshtein.defaultCost]
      induction xs with
      | nil => simp
      | cons z zs ih => simp [levenshtein_cons_nil, Levenshtein.defaultCost] at *; omega
    | cons y ys ihy =>
      rw [editDistance_cons_cons, levenshtein_cons_cons, ihx, ihx, ihy]
      simp only [Levenshtein.defaultCost]
      split_ifs <;> simp <;> omega

#eval Plausible.Testable.check (∀ xs ys : List Nat, editDistance xs ys = editDistance ys xs)
#eval Plausible.Testable.check (∀ xs ys : List Nat, (editDistance xs ys = 0 ↔ xs = ys))
#eval Plausible.Testable.check (∀ xs ys : List Nat, editDistance xs ys = levenshtein Levenshtein.defaultCost xs ys)

end edit_distance
EOF

theorem editDistance_symm {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance xs ys = editDistance ys xs := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ihx =>
    induction ys with
    | nil => simp
    | cons y ys ihy =>
      rw [editDistance_cons_cons, editDistance_cons_cons, ihx, ihx, ihy]
      by_cases h : x = y
      · subst h; simp
      · simp only [h, Ne.symm h, if_false]
        omega

theorem editDistance_le_max {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance xs ys ≤ max xs.length ys.length := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ihx =>
    induction ys with
    | nil => simp
    | cons y ys ihy =>
      rw [editDistance_cons_cons]
      have h1 := ihx ys
      have h2 := ihx (y :: ys)
      have h3 := ihy
      simp only [List.length_cons] at *
      split_ifs <;> omega

theorem length_sub_le_editDistance {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) :
    xs.length - ys.length ≤ editDistance xs ys ∧ ys.length - xs.length ≤ editDistance xs ys := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ihx =>
    induction ys with
    | nil => simp
    | cons y ys ihy =>
      rw [editDistance_cons_cons]
      have h1 := ihx ys
      have h2 := ihx (y :: ys)
      have h3 := ihy
      simp only [List.length_cons] at *
      split_ifs <;> omega

theorem editDistance_eq_zero_iff {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance xs ys = 0 ↔ xs = ys := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => cases ys <;> simp
  | cons x xs ihx =>
    cases ys with
    | nil => simp
    | cons y ys =>
      rw [editDistance_cons_cons]
      split_ifs with h
      · subst h; simp [ihx]
      · simp [h]

theorem editDistance_self {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs : List α) : editDistance xs xs = 0 :=
  (editDistance_eq_zero_iff xs xs).2 rfl

theorem editDistance_lipschitz {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (xs ys : List α), xs.length + ys.length = n →
      (∀ a, editDistance (a :: xs) ys ≤ 1 + editDistance xs ys) ∧
      (∀ a, editDistance xs ys ≤ 1 + editDistance (a :: xs) ys) := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro xs ys hn
    cases ys with
    | nil => constructor <;> intro a <;> simp <;> omega
    | cons b ys' =>
      simp only [List.length_cons] at hn
      constructor
      · intro a
        rw [editDistance_cons_cons]
        split_ifs with h
        · have := (ih (ys'.length + xs.length) (by omega) ys' xs rfl).2 b
          rw [editDistance_symm xs ys', editDistance_symm xs (b :: ys')]
          exact this
        · omega
      · intro a
        rw [editDistance_cons_cons]
        have hL1' : editDistance xs (b :: ys') ≤ 1 + editDistance xs ys' := by
          have := (ih (ys'.length + xs.length) (by omega) ys' xs rfl).1 b
          rw [editDistance_symm xs (b :: ys'), editDistance_symm xs ys']; exact this
        have hL2 : editDistance xs ys' ≤ 1 + editDistance (a :: xs) ys' :=
          (ih (xs.length + ys'.length) (by omega) xs ys' rfl).2 a
        split_ifs <;> omega

theorem editDistance_cons_left_le {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (a : α) (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance (a :: xs) ys ≤ 1 + editDistance xs ys :=
  (editDistance_lipschitz _ xs ys rfl).1 a

theorem editDistance_le_cons_left {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (a : α) (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance xs ys ≤ 1 + editDistance (a :: xs) ys :=
  (editDistance_lipschitz _ xs ys rfl).2 a

theorem editDistance_cons_right_le {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (b : α) (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance xs (b :: ys) ≤ 1 + editDistance xs ys := by
  rw [editDistance_symm xs (b :: ys), editDistance_symm xs ys]
  exact editDistance_cons_left_le b ys xs

theorem editDistance_le_cons_right {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (b : α) (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance xs ys ≤ 1 + editDistance xs (b :: ys) := by
  rw [editDistance_symm xs (b :: ys), editDistance_symm xs ys]
  exact editDistance_le_cons_left b ys xs

theorem editDistance_cons_cons_le {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (a b : α) (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance (a :: xs) (b :: ys) ≤ 1 + editDistance xs ys := by
  rw [editDistance_cons_cons]
  split_ifs <;> omega

theorem editDistance_triangle {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys zs : List α) :
    editDistance xs zs ≤ editDistance xs ys + editDistance ys zs := by
  suffices h : ∀ n, ∀ xs ys zs : List α, xs.length + ys.length + zs.length = n →
      editDistance xs zs ≤ editDistance xs ys + editDistance ys zs from h _ xs ys zs rfl
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro xs ys zs hn
  rcases xs with _ | ⟨a, xs'⟩
  · have := (length_sub_le_editDistance ys zs).2; simp; omega
  rcases zs with _ | ⟨c, zs'⟩
  · have := (length_sub_le_editDistance (a :: xs') ys).1; simp at *; omega
  rcases ys with _ | ⟨b, ys'⟩
  · have := editDistance_le_max (a :: xs') (c :: zs'); simp at *; omega
  simp only [List.length_cons] at hn
  have ih1 := ih _ (by omega) xs' ys' zs' rfl
  have ihA := ih _ (by omega) xs' ys' (c :: zs') rfl
  have ihB := ih _ (by omega) (a :: xs') (b :: ys') zs' rfl
  have ihC := ih _ (by omega) xs' (b :: ys') (c :: zs') rfl
  have ihD := ih _ (by omega) (a :: xs') ys' (c :: zs') rfl
  have L1 := editDistance_cons_left_le a xs' (c :: zs')
  have L2 := editDistance_le_cons_left b ys' (c :: zs')
  have L3 := editDistance_cons_cons_le a c xs' zs'
  have L3' := editDistance_cons_cons_le a b xs' ys'
  have L4 := editDistance_cons_right_le c (a :: xs') zs'
  rw [editDistance_cons_cons a xs' c zs', editDistance_cons_cons a xs' b ys',
    editDistance_cons_cons b ys' c zs'] at *
  split_ifs at * <;> omega

theorem editDistance_append_left {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (ps xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance (ps ++ xs) (ps ++ ys) = editDistance xs ys := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p ps ih => simp [editDistance_cons_cons, ih]

theorem editDistance_insert {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) (a : α) :
    editDistance (xs ++ ys) (xs ++ a :: ys) = 1 := by
  rw [editDistance_append_left]
  have h1 := editDistance_cons_right_le a ys ys
  have h2 := (length_sub_le_editDistance ys (a :: ys)).2
  rw [editDistance_self] at h1
  simp at h2
  omega

theorem editDistance_delete {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) (a : α) :
    editDistance (xs ++ a :: ys) (xs ++ ys) = 1 := by
  rw [editDistance_symm, editDistance_insert]

theorem editDistance_substitute {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) (a b : α) :
    editDistance (xs ++ a :: ys) (xs ++ b :: ys) = if a = b then 0 else 1 := by
  rw [editDistance_append_left, editDistance_cons_cons]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact editDistance_self ys
  · have h1 := editDistance_cons_left_le a ys (b :: ys)
    have h2 := editDistance_le_cons_right b ys ys
    rw [editDistance_self] at h1 h2
    have h3 := editDistance_self ys
    omega

end edit_distance

theorem min9_regroup (t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 t9 : Nat) :
    min (1 + min t1 (min t2 t3)) (min (1 + min t4 (min t5 t6)) (1 + min t7 (min t8 t9))) =
    min (1 + min t1 (min t4 t7)) (min (1 + min t2 (min t5 t8)) (1 + min t3 (min t6 t9))) := by
  simp only [Nat.add_min_add_left]
  ac_rfl

theorem editDistance_concat_concat {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) (x y : α) :
    editDistance (xs ++ [x]) (ys ++ [y]) =
      if x = y then editDistance xs ys
      else 1 + min (editDistance xs (ys ++ [y]))
        (min (editDistance (xs ++ [x]) ys) (editDistance xs ys)) := by
  suffices h : ∀ n, ∀ xs ys : List α, xs.length + ys.length = n →
      editDistance (xs ++ [x]) (ys ++ [y]) =
        if x = y then editDistance xs ys
        else 1 + min (editDistance xs (ys ++ [y]))
          (min (editDistance (xs ++ [x]) ys) (editDistance xs ys)) from h _ xs ys rfl
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro xs ys hn
  rcases xs with _ | ⟨a, xs'⟩ <;> rcases ys with _ | ⟨b, ys'⟩
  · simp only [List.nil_append]
    rw [editDistance_cons_cons]
    simp
    split_ifs <;> simp
  · simp only [List.length_nil, List.length_cons] at hn
    have ih0 := ih _ (by omega) [] ys' rfl
    simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at ih0 ⊢
    rw [editDistance_cons_cons x [] b (ys' ++ [y]), editDistance_cons_cons x [] b ys', ih0]
    simp only [editDistance_nil_left, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · simp only [List.length_nil, List.length_cons] at hn
    have ih0 := ih _ (by omega) xs' [] rfl
    simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at ih0 ⊢
    rw [editDistance_cons_cons a (xs' ++ [x]) y [], editDistance_cons_cons a xs' y [], ih0]
    simp only [editDistance_nil_right, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · simp only [List.length_cons] at hn
    have ih1 := ih _ (by omega) xs' ys' rfl
    have ih2 := ih _ (by omega) xs' (b :: ys') rfl
    have ih3 := ih _ (by omega) (a :: xs') ys' rfl
    simp only [List.cons_append] at ih1 ih2 ih3 ⊢
    rw [editDistance_cons_cons a (xs' ++ [x]) b (ys' ++ [y]), ih1, ih2, ih3,
      editDistance_cons_cons a xs' b ys', editDistance_cons_cons a xs' b (ys' ++ [y]),
      editDistance_cons_cons a (xs' ++ [x]) b ys']
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (congr 1; apply min9_regroup)

theorem editDistance_reverse {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance xs.reverse ys.reverse = editDistance xs ys := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ihx =>
    induction ys with
    | nil => simp
    | cons y ys ihy =>
      have h1 := ihx ys
      have h2 := ihx (y :: ys)
      have h3 := ihy
      simp only [List.reverse_cons] at h2 h3 ⊢
      rw [editDistance_concat_concat, editDistance_cons_cons, h1, h2, h3]

end edit_distance

theorem editDistance_eq_levenshtein {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (xs ys : List α) :
    editDistance xs ys = levenshtein Levenshtein.defaultCost xs ys := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil =>
    induction ys with
    | nil => simp
    | cons y ys ih =>
      rw [levenshtein_nil_cons, ← ih]
      simp only [editDistance_nil_left, List.length_cons, defaultCost_insert]
      omega

      simp only [editDistance_nil_right, List.length_cons, defaultCost_delete]

      simp only [defaultCost_delete, defaultCost_insert, defaultCost_substitute, inf_eq_min]
      split_ifs <;> omega
